title: Electric Shock
summary: Do not touch the person until the power is off. Once safe, check breathing, start CPR if needed and treat burns.

callEmergency.headline: Call {EMERGENCY} for every electric shock injury
when: Any loss of consciousness or breathing problem
Any significant shock – heart rhythm problems can follow

steps.title: Make it safe first
steps.text: Do not touch the person while they may be in contact with electricity. Switch off the power at the mains or unplug if you safely can.

steps.title: High voltage (power lines, rail, industrial)
steps.text: Stay well clear and keep others away. Call {EMERGENCY} and wait until the electricity supplier or emergency services confirm the power is off. Do not try to move wires.
steps.caution: Electricity can arc and travel through the ground. Do not approach.

steps.title: Check response and breathing
steps.text: When safe, check DRABC. If not breathing normally, start CPR and use an AED.

steps.title: Treat burns
steps.text: Look for entry and exit burns. Cool and cover them.

steps.title: Get them checked
steps.text: Everyone who has had a significant electric shock should be medically assessed.

warningSigns: Muscle pain or dark urine later
doNot: Do not touch the casualty until the power is confirmed off
Do not use metal objects to move cables
Do not approach downed power lines
